name: zinterp_context_run_stream
description: zInterp_Context::RunStream tokenizes a line, dispatches builtin/core commands, runs dispatch hooks, and clears temporary token storage.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
RunStream participates in the recursive zInterp execution loop with HandleBuiltinCommand, RunScriptFile, and RunString, so dependency acceptance is made for the group rather than as an isolated leaf.
Binary Ninja shows the call to HandleBuiltinCommand with a stale x87/int80 artifact in some frontier output, but the function and callee contracts are eax-only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja MLIL for 0x4c1090 validates null-line return, parse/line/error reset, non-prepared tokenization, builtin/core dispatch order, hook calls, bad-command logging, deferred hook on line errors, tempAlloc cleanup, and parseResult-derived return.
Native smokes cover RunStream builtin behavior, builtin command handling, and core dispatch integration.
